verdict: usable censored-phase diagnostic; completed quote parity passes; no route completion or latency-win claim

independence.readScope: Four requested primary artifacts and original same-input-cold-source-1/results.json for the expressly requested frozen A comparison. No main assessment, current source, credentials or live state read.

bindingChecks.limitation: Primary artifact bytes independently hashed here. Runtime, binary, runner, inputs, assets and executor post-run immutability are runner-reported assertions in results, not independent filesystem rehashes during this primary-only review.

boundedOutcome.deadlineInterpretation: Approximately 6.55ms scheduling/settlement over the declared work deadline, with physical drain separate; no completion attempt or widened work budget is evidenced.

quoteParity.comparison: Ordered id/hop/canonicalEdgeId/amountIn/amountOut/prefixLength/status projections exactly equal both original A cases; complete Ready data, selected plan hash, runtime and policy also equal.
quoteParity.limits: Both baselines also cancelled without hop2 output. These historical timings are not a paired comparison or proof of instrumentation/provider causality. Primary results do not contain raw per-read EVM return bytes/gas, so quote/plan parity is not a claim of full raw EVM transcript equality.

identityAndQueue.interpretation: Request6's prefix wrapper reports deadline reached; requests4/5 report cancellation. Request6 settled before the shared signal abort and did not escape cancellation into physical execution. There is no pair dispatch or Rust progress for5/6. Result-array settlement order is not execution order.
identityAndQueue.joinLimit: Rust records join directly on captured PID and numeric requestId. Returned wrappers explicitly bind request1/2/3 to exactCallId2. Rejected wrappers omit epoch/requestId; hop2 association is corroborated by the sole pending cohort, matching targets/enqueue times and exact-reserves/input-balance/output-balance failures, not a direct rejected-wrapper ID field.

checks: All interval sequences contiguous from1; elapsed and Unix timestamps monotonic within each interval.
Numeric attempt IDs contiguous within each interval; begin/end identities and phases match; no overlapping attempt scopes.
All observed method histograms complete and sum to logicalItems; no sampled-method loss.
Phase nesting/resumption consistent; completed interval exclusive phase walls and attempt sums match terminals; pair first/bridge/second sum exactly to pair terminal within floating-point tolerance.
All intervals below128 records; no truncation marker. Request4 has127 ordinary records, not evidence of a truncated stream. Its next event could have been the cap marker, but none is observed.
progressIntegrity.endSemantics: An attempt-end means its scope ended, not independently proven RPC success. Request4's missing attempt-end/phase-exit/terminal must remain censored, never zero time or completed work.

censoredRequest4.finding: The predominant observed residual in the censored third hop is serial source storage RPC within full two-hop prefix execution. It is not waiting for queued sibling execution, funding probes, main quote reads or canonical postcheck. No slot/address/key metadata is recorded, so this does not identify duplicate keys, their dependencies, redundant work or a safe batching/cache mechanism.

authorityAndPhysicalAccounting.cancelledRequest: Fresh request4 precheck contributes3 logical calls in1 attempt. No postcheck or accepted result before abort; this is censored execution, not evidence of dropped authority.
authorityAndPhysicalAccounting.doubleCountingRule: Pair terminal totals are not added again to child/bridge records. Nested token phases are not added to their parent wall. JS exact backend and separately recorded direct calls are distinct from Rust sends.
authorityAndPhysicalAccounting.limits: These are observed attempt/envelope counts, including the open attempt, not successful responses, provider-billed CU or a guarantee of provider-side completion. No retry diagnostic stage appears; JS reports zero retries/fallback. Built-in Rust recovery remains allowed and absence of a retry stage is not a universal no-retry guarantee.

cleanupAndFatal.limitations: Cleanup is supported by recorded drain counters and launcher receipt, not a new process inspection. Runner reports24 suppressed ordinary log lines; no claim is made to have inspected suppressed content. Ordinary deadline/transport-cancellation errors are retained, not fatal success results.

executedLocalChecks: Read-only Node/crypto SHA256 and byte lengths for primary artifacts and baseline results; declaration digest binding and embedded spec serialization hash checked.
Node assert/strict exact comparison of all three ordered hop projections, Ready data, selected plan hash, runtime and policy against both frozen A results.
Node assert/strict progress grouping, identities, monotonicity, contiguous sequences/attempt IDs, matching end scopes, phase stack, complete histograms, cap and exclusive terminal sums.
Node assert/strict client dispatch/source, pair bridge counts, emitted children, result and backend drain invariants; log footer parsed and reconciled with results.
finalInterpretation: The diagnostic meets its narrow localization purpose and preserves the two recorded completed quote outputs. The selected P-only route still cancels at30s with no third-hop output and Solver not entered. No systemic, whole-Solver, live or latency improvement is established. A separate mechanism brief remains necessary; this review authorizes no further run or implementation.
